newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank repo average rate rises to 17.43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank repo average rate rises to 17.43 pct.

text.p: The average rate at a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Monday rose to 17.43 percent from 16.50 percent in a similar repo on Friday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS offered 4.0 billion crowns and bids totalled 7.299 billion crowns. The minimum accepted rate was 16.90 percent, while the maximum rate was 18.15 percent.
The NBS added 2.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a one-week repo tender on Friday, with the average rate unchanged from a similar repo on Thursday at 16.50 percent.
According to NBS figures, the banking sector as of July 27 lacked 0.40 percent of the cumulative funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
